channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Heartbroken Iran exit World Cup amid silver lining of Mexican hospitality
item.description: In their three weeks in Tijuana, Iran's players established a reciprocal relationship of love and respect with Mexicans.

item.title: Mourners light candles after deadly German shelter shooting
item.description: Residents lit candles on Monday evening near the site of a shooting that killed six staff members at a German shelter.

item.title: Trump: US envoys enroute to Doha for ‘perhaps important’ Iran meeting
item.description: President Donald Trump said US negotiators are heading to Qatar for what he called a ‘perhaps important’ meeting.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran denies Trump’s claim of meeting in Doha
item.description: Trump says meeting with Iran will take place in Doha today, but Tehran says there are no plans for talks in coming days.

item.title: Israeli strike kills two, setting tents ablaze in Gaza humanitarian zone
item.description: Two people were killed and several others were injured after an Israeli strike hit the Mawasi area of Khan Younis, Gaza.

item.title: US says it has agreed to 'stand down' after exchange of strikes with Iran
item.description: A series of strikes over the weekend saw the US and Iran accuse each other of violating the ceasefire agreement.

item.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
item.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

item.title: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
item.description: The pilot and 10 passengers - including five first-time parachutists - died in the incident, local officials said.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
item.description: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.

item.title: Rescuers keep up search for survivors at collapsed La Guaira building
item.description: At least 1,700 people are known to have been killed in the disaster but hope remains that others can continue to be found alive.
